categories.name: أَنْوَاعُ الْبَشَرِ
categories.nameEn: Human beings mentioned in the Qur'an

items.verse: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
items.verseEn: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?

items.verse: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
items.verseEn: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].

items.verse: قَدْ سَأَلَهَا قَوْمٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحُوا۟ بِهَا كَـٰفِرِينَ
items.verseEn: A people asked such [questions] before you; then they became thereby disbelievers.

items.verse: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِى نَادِيكُمُ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
items.verseEn: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but that they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allāh, if you should be of the truthful."

categories.name: أَنْوَاعُ الْكَلَامِ الْمَنْطُوقِ
categories.nameEn: Types of spoken utterances mentioned in the Qur'an

items.verse: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
items.verseEn: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.

items.verse: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
items.verseEn: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.

items.verse: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
items.verseEn: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"

items.verse: ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةًۭ فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ
items.verseEn: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh, and for them is a humiliating punishment.

categories.name: عَطَايَا اللَّهِ وَجَزَاؤُهُ
categories.nameEn: Gifts and rewards bestowed by Allah

items.verse: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
items.verseEn: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,

items.verse: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
items.verseEn: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].

items.verse: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
items.verseEn: Do they not know that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

items.verse: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُؤْتَوْنَ أَجْرَهُم مَّرَّتَيْنِ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
items.verseEn: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend.

categories.name: مُصْطَلَحَاتُ الْحَرْبِ وَالْقِتَالِ
categories.nameEn: Warfare terms mentioned in the Qur'an

items.verse: فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِم مَّنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
items.verseEn: So if you, [O Muḥammad], gain dominance over them in war, disperse by [means of] them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded.
[Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?
To send down upon them stones of clay,
